caption: The drawing depicts three different views of a metal door latch or handle mechanism, rendered in black ink on a beige background. On the left, there is a front view of a rectangular mounting plate with rounded ends and two screw holes, displaying a curved handle attached to it and a small, curved lever at the top. In the center, a side view shows the profile of the same handle and lever, alongside the thickness of the mounting plate and additional components attached to the edge. To the right, there is a top view of the mechanism, where a straight, narrow bar connects two rectangular plates with visible screw holes, and a circular feature is present near the top plate. All lines are clean and precise, with no additional shading or color apart from the black outline on the beige paper.
title: Attic Door Latch
